run_eval_model: run eval_model to evaluate a finetuned model checkpoint at a given step on a specified task
run_eval_model_skip_convert: run eval_model with skip_convert to skip weight conversion when the HuggingFace checkpoint already exists
run_eval_model_custom_args: run eval_model with additional evaluation arguments passed via the add_eval_args list parameter
run_eval_model_custom_logs: run eval_model with a custom logs_dir_name to change where evaluation logs are saved
run_eval_model_cli: run the eval_model CLI via fire to evaluate a model checkpoint by step, size, and task
